messages:
sarah-support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting the Token Cost dashboard shows $0 or NaN for some orgs since ~00:30 UTC. Affected org example: org_9xZ7AB. CSV export has NaN in the `cost` column. Steps to reproduce attached below. Can we triage?

jordan-support: seeing same for 4 orgs in our ticket queue (TCK-789). All on Hosted API, mixed models. Noticed dashboard sparklines also blank.

matt-eng: assigning to @olivia-data and @lee-eng-infra to triage. Any recent infra/data jobs around that time?

deploy-bot: compact-job/v1.3 finished successfully on shard-7 at 00:25:14 UTC (build 2026.03.15-07).

lee-eng-infra: we deployed the new ledger compaction config yesterday evening to reduce storage. Compaction ran on schedule at ~00:25. Not aware of failing jobs.

olivia-data: looking now. Quick query shows analytics join between usage_ledger -> price_catalog returns NULL for `price_per_token` for certain `quantized_model_id` values introduced in the last model-mapping update. Likely compaction removed some intermediate price keys the join relied on.

olivia-data: repro steps: run this in analytics/analytics-prod: ```sql
SELECT u.org_id, u.model_id, u.quantized_model_id, p.price_per_token
FROM usage_ledger u
LEFT JOIN price_catalog p ON p.model_key = concat(u.model_id, '/', u.quantized_model_id)
WHERE u.org_id = 'org_9xZ7AB'
ORDER BY u.ts DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Result: several rows have p.price_per_token = NULL which downstream agg turns into NaN in the dashboard csv.

matt-eng: can we patch the query to coalesce(p.price_per_token, 0) temporarily? That'd avoid NaN but could mask pricing gaps. Alternate: coalesce to a conservative fallback price (0.0005) and flag rows as fallback.

olivia-data: backfill plan: run a targeted backfill that reconstructs price keys for missing quantized_model_id values from the price metadata snapshot from 03/14. I can start the backfill but it will take ~2 hours for affected shards.

emily-product: product ask — add a visual indicator on the dashboard for rows that used fallback pricing/unknown price, so customers see "estimated" rather than $0. Also want an internal alert when >1% of org rows are fallback.

jordan-support: I'll open/update support tickets and notify impacted customers with a short explanation + ETA. Please paste the final mitigation text here for me to send.

matt-eng: immediate mitigation: pushing a safe hotfix to analytics query to coalesce(price_per_token, 0.0005) and add a `price_source` tag ("catalog|fallback"). This prevents NaN and preserves a visible non-zero cost. PR #1234 created. Will hotfix to prod in 15m pending quick review.

deploy-bot: PR #1234 merged to hotfix at 00:42:10 UTC. Starting canary rollout.

matt-eng: canary looks good on shard-7 after 3 minutes. Rolling to remaining shards now.

olivia-data: starting backfill job for missing price keys (targeted by quantized_model_id) at 00:48 UTC. ETA ~2 hours. Will post progress updates.

lee-eng-infra: note: compaction config reverted on shard-7 (temp) to allow backfill to rehydrate keys if needed. Reversion ID: revert-cfg-2026-03-15-00:55.

emily-product: thanks — Jordan, use this copy for customers: "We've identified a data join gap after a ledger compaction that caused price fields to be missing for a subset of token usage rows. We've deployed a safe fallback to prevent NaN/$0 displays and started a backfill to restore accurate pricing. We expect the backfill to complete in ~2 hours and will reconcile billing where needed.

If you'd like an expedited reconciliation for high-usage periods, reply and we'll prioritize"

jordan-support: sending updates to affected customers now. Will add comment to TCK-789 with links to PR/rollout/backfill.

matt-eng: monitoring metrics — dashboard NaN rate dropped to ~0.2% after hotfix. Backfill progress: 12% (shards 2/8 completed).

olivia-data: backfill 50% complete at 01:30 UTC, discovered ~120 distinct quantized_model_id keys missing; reconstructed from 03/14 snapshot. No data corruption observed.

sarah-support: great, please ping when we can close customer threads and confirm any billing reconciliations. Will queue a follow-up note for customers once backfill finishes.

matt-eng: backfill finished at 02:45 UTC, ran reconciliation script to recompute per-org token costs for affected windows. Reconciliation export generated: s3://redwood-recon/2026-03-15/price-backfill-report.csv.

olivia-data: post-backfill check: dashboard now shows expected non-NaN values for previously affected orgs. Leaving the product flag on to indicate rows that were reconstructed.

emily-product: follow-up action items: 1) Add unit test for ledger compaction->price join to catch missing join keys; 2) Add alert when price_catalog join null rate >0.1%; 3) UI change to show "estimated" when fallback used.

jordan-support: closing customer-facing tickets after final confirmation. Thanks everyone — good SLAs on the hotfix and backfill. :thumbsup:

sarah-support: outstanding — add a short postmortem in #postmortems with timeline + root cause once we have a cleaned writeup. I'll draft it with Olivia and Matt.

olivia-data: I'll start the postmortem draft and include queries, compaction config diff, and the backfill script.

matt-eng: marking incident resolved for now, will reopen if we see any regressions.

deploy-bot: Incident log updated: incident-2026-03-15-compact-price-join; status: resolved."
